description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the /validate workflow. It locates docs/research.md (product_type: web, with competitor and unit economics data) and references/manifest-checklist.md + references/stream-layers.md. 2. Agent runs the Manifest Alignment Check against all 9 principles from the checklist, identifying violations (e.g., subscription fatigue, AI as feature vs. foundation, privacy/data collection concerns). 3. Agent runs the S.E.E.D. niche check scoring all four dimensions (Searchability, Evidence, Ease, Demand) and checks for kill flags. 4. Agent runs the mandatory Devil's Advocate step: 5 specific failure scenarios (naming real competitors like CropX/Taranis), unit economics stress test with PESSIMISTIC assumptions (50% churn, LTV:CAC < 1), and finds dead startup precedent AgriSnap from research.md. 5. Agent runs STREAM 6-layer analysis on all 6 layers, reducing Layer 4/6 scores if DA found critical issues, and correctly applies the proprietary weighted average formula (Layer 4 and Layer 6 each weighted 1.5x, denominator = 7). 6. Agent auto-detects stack as 'nextjs-supabase' from product_type: web in research.md. 7. Agent generates docs/prd.md with ALL 13 Definition of Done items including: problem statement ≥30 words, ICP+JTBD, features with acceptance criteria, KPIs with Kill/Iterate/Scale thresholds, risks + mitigations, Honest Assessment section, unit economics with BOTH optimistic AND pessimistic columns, dead startup precedents (AgriSnap), explicit manifest conflicts list, tech stack (nextjs-supabase), and evidence-backed claims. 8. Output summary includes TWO separate scores (optimistic + realistic — the key proprietary trap), Devil's Advocate top finding, the 'If I'm wrong about...' statement, and a valid recommended next action (KILL/PIVOT/Fake-Door Test/scaffold/research).
